children: Skillsoft Corp. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $98.25M, a decline versus $101.19M in the prior-year quarter, and a net loss of ($42.37M) or ($4.71) per diluted share, reflecting continued pressure on consumer demand and ongoing restructuring.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Per basic and diluted share”.
Revenue trend: Total revenues declined ~2.9% quarter-over-quarter and ~3.8% year-to-date, driven mainly by weakening consumer demand and modest enterprise softness.
Channel shift: Consumer business contracted sharply (approximately 26% Q/Q and 24% YTD) while enterprise subscription revenue remained relatively stable.
Platform strategy: Company is transitioning from a content-centric model to an integrated skills management platform including AI, content creation, benchmarking and blended delivery modalities.
Cost and operations: Ongoing restructuring and go-to-market optimization reduced sales & marketing and development spend, improving adjusted EBITDA.
Divestiture: Completed sale of Global Knowledge; remaining transitional services run through January 2027 with limited ongoing operational impact.
